oneLine: Zetwerk IPO features an OFS where early investors realise Rs 1,215 crore.
seller: Kae Capital, Accel, Peak XV and Lightspeed

sources.title: Zetwerk IPO: Kae Capital, Accel, Peak XV and Lightspeed set to realise ₹1,215 crore
Accel once rejected Zetwerk: Now it sells a slice of its stake in the IPO

synopsis: Early investors in Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses, including venture capital firms Kae Capital, Accel, Peak XV Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners, are set to realise around ₹1215 crore through an offer-for-sale (OFS) component of the company's ₹5012-crore initial public offering. The overall IPO comprises a fresh issue of ₹2830 crore and an OFS of ₹2182 crore. At the issue price of ₹151 per share, these early investors are monetising stakes acquired at significantly lower prices. Kae Capital Fund II and its affiliate Kalysta Capital Fund II are set to realise about ₹253 crore combined. Accel India V is set to realise approximately ₹181 crore. Peak XV's two vehicles will receive around ₹353 crore in total, while Lightspeed Venture Partners across three vehicles expects total proceeds of approximately ₹427 crore. Zetwerk shares listed at ₹159 on October 23, marking a 5 per cent premium to the issue price.
